home.title: Tamdotti – a calm 3D pet game
home.description: Tamdotti is a calm 3D pet game: feed, bathe and cuddle your Dotti, furnish a room, harvest in the garden and meet friends on the meadow. Coming soon to the App Store and Google Play.
home.ogDescription: Look after your Dotti, furnish a room, garden and meadow. Coming soon to the App Store and Google Play.
home.lead: Tamdotti is a calm 3D pet game. You look after your Dotti, make a room for it and head out into the garden together.
home.meta: Coming soon for iPhone and Android.

chapters.title: A room you share.
chapters.text: Bed, rug, lamp, plant: you arrange everything just the way you like it. Feeding, bathing and cuddles all happen right here.

chapters.title: Something’s growing outside.
chapters.text: In the beds you grow strawberries, lettuce and pumpkins. You fetch water from the river, and whatever you harvest goes into your bag as a treat.

chapters.title: And sometimes there’s company.
chapters.text: If you like, you sign in and meet other Dottis on the meadow. You wave to each other, ride the merry-go-round or sit together on the bench. You can also visit friends and have little duels.

home.nopeTitle: What you won’t find in Tamdotti
nope: No banners, no videos in between.
You earn coins by caring and playing.
You only need an account for friends and the online meadow.
home.screensTitle: What it looks like in the app
screens: Garden with beds and a river
Furnishing the house: picking floor and wall
Battle training with stats and energy
home.soonText: Tamdotti is coming soon for iPhone and Android. We’re happy to answer questions before then: {email}
home.storeNote: Not in the store yet – Tamdotti is coming soon.

konto.title: Delete account – Tamdotti
konto.description: How to delete your Tamdotti account and all associated data. Step-by-step guide and an overview of the data that is deleted.
konto.intro: How to delete your account and all associated data in the app “Tamdotti” by Vidomedia UG (haftungsbeschränkt).
konto.requestText: You can request the deletion of your Tamdotti account by email at any time, free of charge:
steps: Send an email to {email} – ideally from the email address linked to your account. Subject: {subject}.

Tell us the email address of your account and how you sign in (email, Google or Apple). If you know it, your username in the app helps too. If you use “Sign in with Apple” with a hidden email, you’ll find the relay address in your Apple ID settings under “Sign in with Apple”.
We briefly check that the request comes from you and delete your account. You’ll receive a confirmation – within one month at the latest, usually much sooner.
mailBody: please delete my Tamdotti account and all associated data.
I sign in with (email / Google / Apple):
konto.deletedIntro: When your account is deleted, we permanently remove all data stored for your account on our servers:
deleted: your user account and sign-in data (email address, password hash or link to Google/Apple),
your profile (username, display name, friend code, avatar, time zone, quiet hours, push token),
your cloud save, your Dottis, abilities, coins, trophies, your inventory and your coin transactions,
visits, battles and duels you took part in, as well as mini-game scores,
memberships in shared Dotti groups and scheduled notifications.
konto.retention: We do not keep any game or account data after deletion. As there are no real-money purchases in Tamdotti, there are no retention obligations for payment data. Short-lived technical logs of our server provider are deleted automatically after a short time; any backups are overwritten in the regular backup cycle. We keep your deletion request email only for as long as needed to show that it was processed.
konto.notice: Please note: Deletion cannot be undone. Your progress, your Dottis and your coins will be lost.
konto.deviceText: If you play without an account, your game data lives only on your device – we then have no data from you on our servers. To delete this local data, simply uninstall the app. If you had an account, sign out in the app under More → Settings → Sign out and uninstall the app to remove the local copy as well.
konto.partialText: Don’t want to delete your whole account, just certain data? Write to us at {email} as well. You can change your username yourself at any time in your profile in the app.
konto.more: You’ll find more information in our {privacy}.
